description: The points that survive an edit, in order, moved where it moves them: what the track editor draws, the same as the server's TrackEdit.Apply. Input: points ([lon, lat, t], t in epoch ms) and an edit as editTrackFold returns it.

cases.name: an empty edit keeps every point
keep holds its two ends, inclusive
remove takes its two ends too, inclusive
a chop, a cut and two deletes
points are named by time, so a drop does not shift a later cut
a moved point keeps its time and place in the order
a moved point that is then deleted is gone
